soap.subjective: Patient reports chest tightness and shortness of breath for 3 days, worsening with exertion (stair climbing). Describes a pressure sensation in the center of the chest. No radiation to arm or jaw. Mild cough without sputum. PMH: hypertension diagnosed 2 years ago. Current medications: lisinopril 10mg daily.
soap.objective: Heart rate 88, regular rhythm. Blood pressure 148/92. Oxygen saturation 96% on room air. Lungs clear bilaterally. Mild accessory muscle use noted. EKG and labs ordered.

assessment.summary: Stable angina in the setting of uncontrolled hypertension. Differential includes ACS (lower probability given exertional pattern and no rest pain).

plan.instructions: Avoid strenuous activity until stress test. Return to ER for chest pain at rest or worsening symptoms.
